emma-cs: Hey team — customer getting 400 on /v1/rerank and all scores return 0. They sent a payload with nested query fields, repro below. Can someone confirm whether nested 'query' or mixed 'documents' + 'candidates' can cause this?

samir-eng: paste the payload they sent pls

emma-cs: ```json
{
  "query": { "q": "best payment gateways" },
  "documents": [
    {"id": "d1", "text": "Payment processors and fees", "metadata": { "query": "internal note"}},
    {"id": "d2", "passages": [{ "text": "Stripe details" }]}
  ],
  "candidates": [{ "id": "c1", "content": "Stripe is good" }]
}
```

Received response: ```json
{ "error": "400 Bad Request", "message": "expected top-level string 'query' but got object", "scores": [0,0,0] }
```

raj-ml: ah — two things: 1) rerank expects top-level 'query' as a string (not nested object or under docs metadata). If client sends {query: {q: ...}} validation can pass in some branches but scoring path will treat query as missing -> zeroed scores. 2) mixed shapes: if 'candidates' items don't use the expected text key (we expect text/content/title), they might be ignored.

samir-eng: +1. also we've seen requests with both 'documents' (with passages) and a separate 'candidates' array create ambiguity in the model selection path. The runtime will try to normalize shape but there's a previous bug where candidate text mapping falls back to empty string when nested keys like 'content' vs 'text' mismatch. That yields scores=0.

infra-bot: logged ingress validation for req id r-8a7c at 2024-12-05T14:22:11Z: "payload_shape: unexpected_object_for_query; candidate_text_missing -> normalized to empty". Linked PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/3421 (patch to stricter validation + clearer error messages).

olivia-sre: workaround for customers ASAP: flatten query to top-level string, and provide candidates as simple array of strings or objects with explicit "text" key. Example payload to send: ```json
{
  "query": "best payment gateways",
  "candidates": [
    { "id": "c1", "text": "Stripe is good" },
    { "id": "c2", "text": "PayPal fees and limits" }
  ]
}
```

raj-ml: For longer-term: we should update docs to state precedence rules when both documents and candidates present, and add a stricter server-side validation error (400) that returns field path like "query" or "candidates[0].text" missing. Filed DOC-983.

emma-cs: Thanks — I'll send the flattened payload and note the bug/PR to the customer. I'll also ask them to retry after we deploy PR. Any quick repro steps I should include?

samir-eng: Ask them to: 1) send original broken payload, capture request id, 2) send flattened payload, 3) include request ids + server logs (we can map). Mention payload size too — if their documents are large we hit truncation that can strip fields.

emma-cs: perfect, thanks :pray: I'll follow up once customer confirms.

infra-bot: Note: workaround applied in ingress for r-8a7c to return clear validation error for nested 'query' in next deploy.
